description: Look up Docker images in claytono/renovate-docker-datasource, which dates each tag by its Docker Hub push date or by when it was first seen elsewhere

packageRules.description: Look up versioned Docker tags in the image's file. The nested replaces turn the name as written (nginx, linuxserver/sonarr) into the file's path (docker.io/library/nginx, docker.io/linuxserver/sonarr). The URL is set here rather than as the datasource's default so that it replaces any registry URL a repository sets. Floating tags such as latest or stable are not versions to Renovate, which only updates their digest, so they stay on the Docker datasource.
